project.name: deltempo
project.description: Free, open-source disk cleaner and RAM optimizer for Windows 10 and 11 that reclaims temp files, AppData junk and GPU shader caches, with a deep app uninstaller and duplicate file finder. Ships as a WinUI 3 desktop app, a WPF shell and a headless CLI. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.name: apply-repo-settings.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that makes .github/settings.yml real: it validates every workflow file, applies the declared label taxonomy with idempotent `gh label create --force`, then re-reads the live repository and fails loudly when declared state diverges from reality. It deliberately calls the GitHub API directly instead of an unpinnable third-party settings action.
nodes.languageNotes: YAML workflow driven by inline PyYAML and bash (set -euo pipefail); every action is pinned by commit SHA rather than a mutable tag.

nodes.name: checkmarx-one.yml
nodes.summary: Runs a Checkmarx One SAST/SCA/KICS scan on pull requests targeting main, gated on the CX_CLIENT_ID/CX_CLIENT_SECRET secrets, and uploads the resulting SARIF report to GitHub code scanning.

nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: Primary CI quality gate on push and pull request to main: restores and builds deltempo.sln, fails closed on vulnerable NuGet packages and on defect-indicating analyzer rules, verifies formatting, runs the xUnit v3 / Microsoft.Testing.Platform suite with per-scope Cobertura coverage floors (Core 76%, WinUI shell 23%), and publishes SBOM and test artifacts. A second job builds and packs the WinUI Store flavor (.msix, asInvoker) as a Store submission gate.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy inline PowerShell: each gate treats a non-zero or unrecognised tool result as failure instead of parsing for a success string, and the MTP summary is parsed rather than the process exit code.

nodes.name: codacy.yml
nodes.summary: Codacy Analysis CLI security scan producing SARIF for GitHub code scanning. A guard step skips the scan with an explicit warning when CODACY_PROJECT_TOKEN is absent, so an unconfigured scanner no longer reads as a failed or passing scan.

nodes.name: codeql.yml
nodes.summary: CodeQL C# analysis with security-extended queries on push, pull request, a weekly schedule and manual dispatch; restores and builds deltempo.sln before the analyze step and uploads results under the /language:csharp category.

nodes.name: devskim.yml
nodes.summary: Microsoft DevSkim security-lint scan on push, pull request and a weekly schedule. Runs with -E so the exit code reflects real findings, but limits severities to Critical/Important/Moderate so ManualReview notes and vendored libraries no longer fail the build; results upload as SARIF.

nodes.name: pages.yml
nodes.summary: Deploys the static site in ./docs to GitHub Pages whenever files under docs/ change, uploading the folder with include-hidden-files so .nojekyll survives and Jekyll does not reprocess the published output.

nodes.name: release.yml
nodes.summary: Tag-triggered release pipeline: resolves the tag through the environment (never string-interpolated into scripts), validates it against Directory.Build.props, runs the full test suite, publishes self-contained single-file WPF GUI and CLI binaries for win-x64 and win-arm64 plus WinUI 3 preview archives, Authenticode-signs and verifies them, generates a re-verified SHA-256 manifest, optionally packs MSIX, pins winget manifests, and attaches every asset fail-closed.
nodes.languageNotes: Tag values travel via env vars to avoid script injection in the job holding the signing certificate; checksum generation runs strictly after signing because Authenticode rewrites the PE bytes.

nodes.name: soak.yml
nodes.summary: Nightly advisory soak job that runs the 1,000,000-case Category=FuzzDeep campaign against the path canonicalizer, off the pull-request critical path. It parses the test summary instead of trusting the exit code and fails when the filter matches zero tests, so a renamed trait cannot silently stop the fuzzing.

nodes.name: validate-workflows.yml

nodes.languageNotes: Runs on ubuntu-latest because its python3 ships PyYAML, avoiding a network dependency on the Windows build runners.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README: Deltempo is a free, open-source Windows 10/11 disk cleaner and memory optimizer shipped as a WPF GUI (src/Deltempo.App.Wpf) plus a headless CLI, with a WinUI 3 shell in parity preview, all on top of one Core library.

tour.title: Solution and Build Graph
tour.description: The solution and the central MSBuild/NuGet files define the four projects and pin every dependency version used by all of them.

tour.title: CLI Entry Point
tour.description: The headless host: Program.cs parses arguments and forwards them to the Core command runner, giving the same engine a scriptable surface.

tour.title: WinUI 3 Shell Bootstrap
tour.description: App.xaml.cs enforces single-instance behaviour and launches MainWindow, which hosts the workspace views and the shared view models.

tour.title: Cleaning Pipeline
tour.description: A cleanup runs plan → execute → transaction: the planner produces a CleanupPlan, the executor performs the deletions and the transaction records what can be rolled back.

tour.title: Safety and Protection Rules
tour.description: Before anything is deleted, the safety layer classifies paths and risk tiers so protected system locations and unsafe operations are refused.

tour.title: Scanning and Discovery
tour.description: File discovery walks volumes through the native scanner and the USN journal, coordinated per volume to keep scans fast and cancellable.

tour.title: Service Layer
tour.description: The Core service layer turns the engines into features: memory optimization, app uninstall, large-file hunting, startup management and system repair.

tour.title: Self-Update Pipeline
tour.description: Update checks, manifest signature and patch integrity verification, and a transactional coordinator protect the in-place update path.

tour.title: CI, Release and Packaging
tour.description: GitHub Actions builds and tests every change, then the release workflow produces the signed executables and MSIX/WinGet manifests.
